scope: Read-only review of the proposed B01 profile registry/snapshot implementation plan; no product or test implementation.

original_b01_scope.details: B01 workflow registry, validators, and immutable profile snapshots match backlog B01. The plan correctly keeps B02 user authorization/database/workspaces and B03 durable Temporal/outbox/human-wait execution separate. Existing AX GET-only transcript API remains untouched.

profile_field_inventory.details: The planned profile shape accounts for every top-level and nested field in the source example, including versions, all three quality tools, device, release, approval, and validation. The new project-profile JSON Schema is explicitly identified as an implementation artifact, not an original contract.

mode_and_authority_boundary.details: Mock/real, enabled, completeness, external operational checks, and approval are reported separately. Configuration completeness never grants execution/release authority; the supplied disabled mock example remains unchanged.

job_workflow_version_mapping.details: The plan explicitly maps Job.workflow_version as a lookup reference to the immutable workflow registry ID (workflow_id=ifpmic-sw-v1), with the registry enforcing pinned content. It correctly keeps schema_version=1.0.0 as document-format version rather than behavior version.

snapshot_and_publication.details: The proposed deterministic envelope, payload hash, immutable version key, deep-frozen return, temp write/file sync/close, create-once hardlink, directory sync, uncertain publication result, no rollback, corruption checks, and independent-process fault/race matrix address the senior architecture advice. However, the plan says the registry supplies workflow, state, and agent contracts while binding the snapshot and workflow_version only to workflow.v1.json raw SHA. State/agent contract changes could therefore alter execution behavior without changing the pinned snapshot identity.

profile_completeness_rules.details: Schema-required fields are enumerated, but real-mode completeness only says that empty required collections are unresolved. It does not define which of driver_paths, test_paths, artifact_patterns, sqe_expected_cases, and reviewers must be nonempty, nor whether requirements vary by release mode or profile purpose. The checker result and --require-real-config exit status would otherwise depend on an unspecified rule.

acceptance_scope.details: The plan does not claim B01 unit checks execute full AT-04 or AT-28. It correctly says full AT-04 requires X01 execution-plan/skip evidence behavior and full AT-28 requires later real-release enforcement. Keep those original cases not-executed until their service behaviors are implemented.

verification_stage_design.details: P0-P6 provide distinct purpose, target, method, owner, pass result, evidence, and recovery/reverification paths; tests cover parser boundaries, deterministic identity, real processes, publication faults, CLI privacy, and integration gates. The conditional skip of the existing 11-command UI/browser gate is technically justified only when source and build/plugin output bytes equal the accepted controls candidate. Before relying on that skip, the implementation evidence must identify the exact accepted baseline candidate/artifacts and their hashes; the plan currently names the candidate generically.

blocking_findings.issue: Snapshot identity does not bind every contract that the registry claims to provide.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Either narrow the registry's B01 responsibility to the workflow.v1.json contract only, or define a versioned immutable contract bundle and bind the state-contract.json and agent-contract.json source hashes (and any other behavior-defining inputs) into the snapshot/workflow reference. Preserve raw source SHA values distinctly from canonical hashes.

blocking_findings.issue: Real-mode completeness has no explicit per-collection rules.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: List the exact real-mode nonempty requirements for each array field and any conditional rules by release mode/profile purpose, or explicitly state that all profile arrays may be empty and point to a separate completeness policy. Add independent fixed expectations to P1 cases.

blocking_findings.issue: The UI gate skip lacks a pinned accepted-candidate identity.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Name the existing accepted controls candidate/evidence manifest and record its relevant source/build/plugin artifact hashes in implementation evidence before using the conditional skip. If they cannot be established, run the 11-command gate.

acceptance_and_safety_notes: AT-04 and AT-28 remain original acceptance IDs with not-executed status; B01 preflight mechanics alone cannot satisfy either whole case.
No profile secret values were copied or needed for this review.
No original contract was changed; no code or tests were implemented.
reviewer_verdict: Do not begin product implementation against this exact plan revision. Resolve the three blocking findings, update the plan, and obtain a new review against its new SHA.
